title: Endline reading comprehension
instructions: Read the passage, then answer all five questions before submitting the protected form.

parts.prompt: Why did the group observe visitors before replacing the signs?

options.text: To identify where navigation problems actually occurred
To count every mangrove tree
To close the walkway on weekends
To prove that all old signs were useless

choice_rationales.A: The observations locate moments of visitor confusion.
choice_rationales.D: The group retained most old signs.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The initial observation tested where visitors needed clearer guidance.

parts.prompt: In the final paragraph, what does “the result” refer to?

options.text: The weather becoming calmer
Fewer visitors asking for directions after temporary signs were installed
Every sign being permanently replaced
The first observation period lasting six weekends

choice_rationales.A: Weather is a limitation, not the measured result.
choice_rationales.B: This outcome appears immediately before the reference.
choice_rationales.C: Only temporary signs were installed at two junctions.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “The result” refers to the reduction in requests for directions.

parts.prompt: What does “revealed” most nearly mean in paragraph 2?

options.text: made known
deliberately concealed
carelessly copied
permanently solved

choice_rationales.A: The map made the pattern visible.
choice_rationales.D: The map identified rather than solved the issue.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Revealed” means showed or made something previously unclear known.

parts.prompt: Which statement best expresses the main idea?

options.text: Long paths always require more signs than short ones
Visitor questions should replace all observation
Targeted changes tested with evidence can be more useful than replacing everything immediately
Temporary signs are suitable for every nature reserve

choice_rationales.B: The group used both observation and questions.
choice_rationales.C: This captures the measured, targeted approach.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The passage centres on locating the real problem, testing a limited response and retaining caution.

parts.prompt: Which inference is best supported by the final paragraph?

options.text: The group understood that calmer weather might partly affect the comparison
The group had already ordered permanent signs
No visitors became confused during the second period
The temporary signs were removed immediately

choice_rationales.A: The weather difference is explicitly treated as a limitation.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The cautious conclusion recognises weather as a possible alternative influence.
